reportedIssues: The cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are not aligned. Green Bowl Poké has a taller image (starting near y≈631) than Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccola (starting near y≈658). Their titles and delivery-fee text therefore sit at different vertical positions (801 vs 829), and the time badges are offset too.
The secondary gray text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', the '(500+)' rating count) and the inactive tab labels are light gray on white and have low contrast.
The heart/favorite buttons are inconsistent. On the ramen card the heart has no background, so it may be hard to see against the image. On the pizza card it has a dark circular background.
The promo banner's decorative circles are cropped awkwardly at the right and bottom edges, and one of them has a hard-edged corner artifact at the bottom right.
